message.description: The message of the alert, limited to 130 characters.

alias.description: Client-defined identifier for the alert, used for deduplication.

description.description: A detailed description of the alert.

responders.description: Teams, users, escalations, and schedules that the alert is routed to.

visibleTo.description: Teams and users that the alert will become visible to without sending notifications.

actions.description: Custom actions available for the alert.

tags.description: Tags to attach to the alert.

details.description: Custom key-value pairs to attach to the alert.

entity.description: Entity field of the alert, used to specify the domain of the alert.

source.description: Source field of the alert, used to specify the source of the alert.

priority.description: Priority level of the alert. P1 is the highest, P5 is the lowest.

user.description: Display name of the request owner.

note.description: Additional note to add to the alert when created.
